title: VACUUM CONTROL ASM. & CABLES
summary: Heater/AC control head (the heater control panel in the center console/dash) and its vacuum hoses and temperature cable, all models. The control assembly is screwed into the dash; the blower switch screws to the control, the temperature cable housing is clamped to the control with a screw, and the multi-tube vacuum control hose harness runs to the vacuum valves (actuators) on the heater & defroster box, where its ends are held by clips. A tee is spliced into the yellow-stripe windshield wiper vacuum hose, and one line goes to the rear vent vacuum door.

fastening.note: Screw [1] goes down through the corner tab of the control assembly [2] faceplate (main view, upper right).

View B: one screw asm. [3] (1 REQ'D) clamps the temperature cable [7] housing to the side of the control [2] (torque triangle 2 here).
View B: screw [6] goes through the ear of the switch [4] into the bracket on the control [2]; the wiring harness plugs into the switch (see UPC 12).
View B: one push-on nut [5] (1 REQ'D) goes on a stud from below the control [2]; the stud is part of the control/linkage, no separate stud part.

fastening.note: View A: clip [11] holds the end of the vacuum hose [8] onto the valve asm. nipple. Typical 2 places.
View C: hose [8] end pushes onto the valve asm. fitting (typical 2 places).
Cut the yellow-stripe wiper vac hose about 4 in. from its end and fit tee [9] in it; the tee's branch goes to hose [8].
Clamp [10] holds the vacuum hoses at the left end of the run (main view); separate unnumbered CLIPS hold the hoses along the dash.
Main view: cable [7] runs from the control [2] to the heater box; its heater-box end attachment is not shown on this sheet.
